negative_mutations.name: lease
negative_mutations.exact_patch:
--- normal/world_gameplay_prefetch.gd
+++ lease/world_gameplay_prefetch.gd
@@ -64,8 +64,8 @@
     var record: Dictionary = _configs[id]
     # Published configs are immutable. Identity catches a replacement with the
     # same path/stamp; value checks catch a changed entrance or source lease.
-    return not record.get("raw", {}).is_empty() and is_same(cache.source_record, record) \
-        and is_same(cache.raw, record.get("raw")) and is_same(cache.prepared, record.get("prepared")) \
+    return not record.get("raw", {}).is_empty() and true \
+        and true and true \
         and cache.entry == candidate.entry and cache.path == candidate.path \
         and cache.path == record.get("path", candidate.path) and cache.stamp == record.stamp \
         and cache.stamp == FileAccess.get_modified_time(cache.path)

limits: 2ms is admission only; a single operation can exceed it (an independent 32-step deep-copy run observed 5107 microseconds).
Comparator-equal compatibility sorting is unpreemptible and retains O(n) references; ordinary selection retains at most 12 winners.

The local final run covers 11 related suites, strict imports, normal-damage live adoption and 6 artwork probes, not the complete default suite. Exact-head CI is checked separately.
Pre-existing ObjectDB warnings in other suites remain visible and are not treated as a proved planner defect or globally fixed audio lifecycle.
